decisions.reason: Proven government use and connections to over 30 APIS schemes keep results well above aspiration, and the product sits at the core of the firm's aviation business.

Post-pandemic demand for travel health information is weak and there are still no reported results, so performance likely falls below aspiration; the expanding firm's slack lets this low-cost API stay another year while problemistic search considers folding it into document verification.
The cyber awareness module is cheap to run within the certified-trainer offer and meets rising compliance demand, so slack easily carries it despite no reported results.
Behaviour analysis fits the firm's detection expertise and its airport innovation strategy, and with turnover growing the firm can tolerate results that are still uncertain.
Passenger profiling is a differentiating method embedded in the integrated aviation offer and costs little to maintain, so there is no trigger for search.
The verification platform complements the successful passenger data solution and has its own page, so the firm stays committed while results develop.
